C1.claim: H1 external context converges on the wrong foil.

C2.claim: H2 derivable context resolves correctly across tiers.

C3.claim: The ensemble collapses to one effective voice.

C5.claim: The H1 failure is silent rather than uncertain.

C6.claim: Verdicts use executable gold rather than an LLM judge.

alt_text: The figure sends one underspecified prompt through the same five-agent roster, then forks on whether the deleted disambiguating clause is outside or inside the prompt. With the clause outside (H1), five-of-five agreement selects the foil, yielding a wrong verdict and only one effective voice; with it inside (H2), parallel agents select the target and are correct. The contrast shows that failure follows the clause's location rather than model capability.
